sentence: She had her car serviced, because regular ______ keeps the engine running well. (maintain)
explanation: After the adjective 'regular' we need a noun naming the action of keeping the car in good condition. The suffix -ance turns the verb maintain into the noun maintenance. Learners may be tempted to use the verb here, but English requires a noun after an adjective.
